title: Master Type Design (écal)
info: 2016학년도에 신설된, 스위스에서 유일한 서체 디자인 석사 과정입니다. 그래픽 디자인 학사 학위가 있는 대학원생이 장기 프로젝트를 개발할 수 있게 하며, 캘리그래피·곡선 작업·구성·디지털 드로잉 등 서체 특유의 기법과 다중 문자 폰트 패밀리 개발을 다룹니다. 학위는 Master of Arts HES-SO in Design, major in Type Design입니다. At the start of the 2016 academic year, ECAL is proud to have introduced a new Master’s degree in Type Design. Unique in Switzerland, this two-year program gives graduate students with a Bachelor in Graphic Design an opportunity to develop projects in the long term. Master of Arts HES-SO in Design, major in Type Design.

>
> At the start of the 2016 academic year, ECAL is proud to have introduced a new Master’s degree in Type Design. Unique in Switzerland, this two-year program gives graduate students with a Bachelor in Graphic Design an opportunity to develop projects in the long term. Master of Arts HES-SO in Design, major in Type Design.
